prompt:

Preserve her exact short dark hair, moss-green rolled-sleeve blouse, cream waist apron with crossed straps behind, brown trousers and shoes, stocky proportions, dark pixel outlines, warm palette and steep overhead orthographic B camera. The visible crown of her head must be large; keep the compressed face and torso. Do not flatten to an eye-level view. Crisp coherent pixel clusters, no painted texture noise, no antialiasing, no gradients.
Output exactly THREE columns and FOUR rows on a 960x1408 canvas, cells 320x352. Each cell contains one whole figure about 145 pixels wide and 270 pixels tall, centered on x=160 with bottommost foot y=328 relative to its cell. Generous empty margins. NEVER draw grid lines, labels, lettering or cast shadows.
Row 1: all three figures face SOUTH towards viewer. Row 2: all three face WEST left profile. Row 3: all three face EAST right profile. Row 4: all three face NORTH away; backs only, no face or cheek. Do NOT copy the erroneous directions in the reference outer columns.

Exactly twelve independent complete figures.
